scope: Distinguish the Cover DWG's unclaimed AC1027 HEADER bytes from decompressor/page capacity and from the ODA specification's separately located R13C3+ padding, using a current-source trace and ODA v5.4.1.

observations.source: The local Cover.dwg identifies as AC1027. Its input SHA-256 matches the existing Cover source bound by earlier receipts.
observations.traceLines: The receipt-bound current-source trace prints the section name/id, page uSize, parser input size, internal declared size, payload end, trailer end, and unclaimed byte count. The parser bounds the logical header envelope at the section-map data size (1575), not the 1600-byte page uSize or the 29696-byte decompressor window.

authorities.odaSection9: ODA v5.4.1 §9, printed p.72: HEADER is a contiguous stream consisting of beginning sentinel, declared size, data, CRC and ending sentinel; the section text says there are no gaps and only bit padding to the next byte boundary.
authorities.odaSection11: ODA v5.4.1 §11, printed p.89: the 0x200 R13C3+ padding chapter follows §10 AcDb:Classes; it does not describe bytes inside the AcDb:Header section.
authorities.odaSectionMap: ODA v5.4.1 §4 page/section map: the section map's Data size and per-page uncompressed size are distinct fields; the concatenated pages form the section.

interpretation.proven: For this Cover source, 731 unclaimed bytes are inside the section-map-declared 1575-byte AcDb:Header span. They are not the separate 25-byte page-uSize tail or the documented post-CLASSES 0x200 padding.
interpretation.notProven: The content or producer role of the 731 bytes is unknown. This single-source span does not explain the 28,852/28,844-byte AC1027 controlled ODA outputs or establish a universal rule across producers/revisions.
interpretation.decision: Keep the Cover suffix unclaimed and strict complete output refused. Do not change parser admission or label the bytes as padding from this evidence.

validation.result: Trace reached HEADER parsing; recorded data-size boundaries and existing 731-byte unclaimed-suffix refusal. No fixture or generated DWG was committed.

nextReadyPacket: For any further ODA-resaved suffix comparison, bind section-map Data size separately from page uSize and decompressor capacity, and obtain eligible source-level producer/layout evidence before changing the strict gate.
